control_failures.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: corrective action - critical control at P-3221

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on P-3221 and PT-3221 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically authorising a group isolation. P-3221 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 27 August 2018 a corrective action on P-3221 and PT-3221 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the critical control it was raised to restore.
